headline: Hubtown merger of Saicharan Consultancy and 25 West Realty via scheme of arrangement
sum: Hubtown Limited announced a scheme of arrangement involving the merger of two private companies-Saicharan Consultancy Private Limited and 25 West Realty Private Limited-into Hubtown. The scheme was disclosed to NSE on 23 June 2026 via official press release.
detail: Hubtown Limited, a listed real estate developer based in Mumbai, announced a composite merger integrating two private entities-Saicharan Consultancy Private Limited and 25 West Realty Private Limited-through a formal scheme of arrangement. The transaction was announced via a press release filed with NSE on 23 June 2026. The scheme would require National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) sanction and shareholder approval at a general meeting. Real estate consolidation mergers of this type are typically structured as all-stock transactions or involve mixed consideration and are used to pool development assets or land banks.
